items.titleEn: Blue Jays claim Sewald off waivers to bolster weary bullpen
bodyEn: The Toronto Blue Jays claimed right-hander Paul Sewald off waivers from the Arizona Diamondbacks on Wednesday.

Sewald, 36, has appeared in 45 contests for the Diamondbacks this season, posting a 6.23 ERA with a 1.10 WHIP, a .228 opponent average, a 5.5% walk rate, and a 27.0% strikeout rate, while ranking T-4th in the NL in saves (24). The right-hander from Las Vegas, Nev., was selected by the New York Mets in the 10th round of the 2012 First-Year Player Draft out of the University of San Diego, making his MLB debut with the club in 2017. Over 10 MLB seasons, Sewald has suited up for the Mets, Mariners, Diamondbacks, Guardians, and Tigers, appearing in 426 games, posting a 4.30 ERA with a 1.14 WHIP, a .220 opponent average, a 7.8% walk rate, a 28.4% strikeout rate, and 110 saves.
Additionally, right-hander Jake Bloss has been recalled to the Major League roster and placed on the 60-day injured list.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟签下塞瓦尔德补强疲弱牛棚
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟从自由球员市场签下右投保罗·塞瓦尔德以补强牛棚。
bodyZh: 多伦多蓝鸟周三从小联盟自由球员市场签下右投保罗·塞瓦尔德，以补强疲弱的牛棚。

现年36岁的塞瓦尔德本赛季为亚利桑那响尾蛇出战45场，自责分率6.23，WHIP 1.10，对手打击率.228，保送率5.5%，三振率27.0%，在国家联盟救援成功次数上并列第4（24次）。这位拉斯维加斯出生的右投手在2012年选秀第10轮被纽约大都会选中，2017年完成大联盟首秀。在10个大联盟赛季中，他曾效力于大都会、水手、响尾蛇、守护者和老虎，出战426场，自责分率4.30，WHIP 1.14，对手打击率.220，保送率7.8%，三振率28.4%，累计110次救援成功。
此外，右投杰克·布洛斯已被召回大联盟名单，并放入60天伤病名单。

items.titleEn: Watch prospects play at Triple-A for FREE on Saturday
bodyEn: All season long, baseball fans can watch Minor League Baseball games for free on the Bally Sports Live app or at BallySports.com. Fans may also purchase an MLB+ subscription, which includes access to MiLB games live and on demand, live MLB audio for all 30 teams, MLB Network, and MLB Big Inning.
Get tickets to a Minor League game near you »
Plus -- with or without a subscription -- Minor League games featuring MLB's top prospects are available FREE at the top of this article and on the MLB Pipeline and MiLB homepages.
Tuesday

3:05 p.m. ET: Reno Aces (AZ) vs. Tacoma Rainiers (SEA)After homering four times in July, Lazaro Montes (SEA No. 4/MLB No. 38) is back to hammering big flies in bunches. The 6-foot-5 slugger with 65-grade pop matched last month's total over a three-game stretch last week -- and organization mate Michael Arroyo (SEA No. 5/MLB No. 40) also swatted three. They are a daunting pair for opposing hurlers with a combined 48 roundtrippers this season. Starring offensively for Triple-A Reno will be steady hitter Demetrio Crisantes (AZ No. 1/MLB No. 85). Known for his bat-to-ball ability, Crisantes has reached base in all seven games to start the month, highlighted by three multihit performances.

7:30 p.m. ET: St. Paul Saints (MIN) vs. Iowa Cubs (CHC)Two days before the Twins and Phillies meet in Dyesrville, Iowa, these nearby Triple-A teams will meet face off for MiLB at Field of Dreams. Both teams will play in throwback alternate uniforms reminiscent of the 1998 film that inspired the event. The spectacle will be packed with talent too, including the 2023 fifth overall Draft pick. Outfielder Walker Jenkins (MIN No. 1/MLB No. 14) is a potential five-tool player with standout power. Iowa's lineup is led by recently promoted switch-hitting catcher Owen Ayers (CHC No. 2), who has used his strong plate discipline and raw power to rank among the Minor League leaders in OPS.
Wednesday

6:30 p.m. ET: Winston-Salem Dash (CWS) vs. Greensboro Grasshoppers (PIT)Roch Cholowsky has been showing why he was selected with the No. 1 pick in July's Draft. Through his first four games for High-A Winston-Salem, the UCLA star tallied five hits (including a homer), seven RBIs, two runs and three walks. Sporting multiple plus tools, Cholowsky will look to build on his positive first impression as the White Sox affiliate takes on Greensboro and powerful teenage hitter Edward Florentino (PIT No. 2/MLB No. 28). Signed out of the Dominican Republic in 2024, the 6-foot-3 outfielder is one of seven teenagers with 19+ homers.
Thursday

7:35 p.m. ET: Chattanooga Lookouts (CIN) vs. Montgomery Biscuits (TB)Few players have boosted their stock recently as much as Theo Gillen (TB No. 1/MLB No. 9) this season. The 2024 first-rounder entered the week with career highs in every offensive statistical category, including homers (20), stolen bases (39) and OPS (1.007). He uses his dynamic mix of speed and power to routinely lace extra-base hits. Sharing a lineup with Gillen is another offensive force in switch-hitting backstop Caden Bodine (TB No. 3/MLB No. 90), who has a knack for barreling sharp line drives. Leading Double-A Chattanooga are infielders Cam Collier (CIN No. 12) and Carlos Sanchez (CIN No. 13). Drafted in the first round in 2022, Collier has impressive raw power. Sanchez stands out for his selective approach and high contact rates.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
Friday

7 p.m. ET: Chesapeake Baysox (BAL) vs. Reading Fightin Phils (PHI)In his first game with his new organization, Orioles Trade Deadline acquisition Anthony Eyanson (BAL No. 1/MLB No. 49) racked up nine punchouts over five two-run frames for Double-A Chesapeake. What will his second outing bring? The 21-year-old right-hander with elite spin rates toes the rubber against fellow Top 100 hurler Gage Wood (PHI No. 1/MLB No. 48). The 2025 first-rounder possesses a 70-grade four-seamer that could already play in The Show and is one of the top offerings in the Minors. Rounding out the 2025 draftees in the matchup is Wehiwa Aloy (BAL No. 5) -- the 2025 Golden Spikes Award winner. Aloy was recently promoted after belting 15 homers and slashing .300/.371/.503 across 84 games at High-A.
Saturday

4:05 p.m. ET: Buffalo Bisons (TOR) vs. Worcester Red Sox (BOS)Since his promotion to Triple-A Worcester on July 25, Franklin Arias (BOS No. 1/MLB No. 7) has been unstoppable with runners in scoring position. The electric 20-year-old -- who pairs plus fielding with a potent hit tool and sneaky pop -- entered the week with 14 RBIs and three homers on 15 knocks through his first 12 games at the new level. Taking the field opposite Arias will be Sean Keys (TOR No. 5), a strapping infielder with time in the bigs this season and solid tools across the board.
Sunday

1:05 p.m. ET: South Bend Cubs (CHC) vs. Great Lakes Loons (LAD)Power. Speed. Hitting. High-A Great Lakes' trio of Top 100 prospects is one of the most dynamic groups in the Minors. Headlining the squad is outfielder Eduardo Quintero (LAD No. 3/MLB No. 19), who entered the week with a system-leading 37 stolen bases and a .931 OPS. Emil Morales (LAD No. 4/MLB No. 24) has some of the best pop of any shortstop in the Minors, while Charles Davalan (LAD No. 6/MLB No. 81) has found a new gear over the past few weeks with multiple knocks in five of his first six games this month. On the other side of the showdown is Josiah Hartshorn (CHC No. 1/MLB No. 60). Drafted in the sixth round last year, the 19-year-old switch-hitter has massive pop from both sides of the dish and leads all Cubs Minor Leaguers with 92 RBIs.

8 p.m. ET: Arkansas Travelers (SEA) vs. Tulsa Drillers (LAD)Dueling Top 100 prospects take center stage in this Double-A bout. The loud bats of Josue De Paula (LAD No. 1/MLB No. 4) and Mike Sirota (LAD No. 2/MLB No. 11) anchor the Tulsa lineup. Both have a knack for collecting knocks and getting on base, using a selective approach before unleashing on pitches in the zone. On Arkansas' side, twitchy switch-hitting shortstop Felnin Celesten (SEA No. 3/MLB No. 36) and speedy outfielder Jonny Farmelo (SEA No. 6/MLB No. 59) are at the forefront. The pair was recently promoted after tearing up the High-A Northwest League.

此外——无论是否订阅——可在本文顶部以及 MLB Pipeline 和 MiLB 主页免费观看以 MLB 顶级潜力新秀为特色的小联盟比赛。
星期二

3:05 p.m. ET：Reno Aces (AZ) 对阵 Tacoma Rainiers (SEA)。在七月四次本垒打之后，Lazaro Montes（西雅图水手第4号新秀/MLB第38号）重新开始成串轰出本垒打。这位身高6英尺5英寸、拥有65级力量评分的重炮手在上周的三场比赛中追平了上个月的总数——同队队友 Michael Arroyo（西雅图水手第5号新秀/MLB第40号）也击出三支本垒打。他们本赛季合计轰出48支本垒打，是对手投手令人生畏的组合。为3A Reno 在进攻端领衔的是稳定击球手 Demetrio Crisantes（亚利桑那响尾蛇第1号新秀/MLB第85号）。Crisantes 以其击球能力著称，本月开始的前七场比赛全部上垒，其中三场是多安打表现。

7:30 p.m. ET：St. Paul Saints (MIN) 对阵 Iowa Cubs (CHC)。在双城队和费城人队在爱荷华州 Dyesrville 交手前两天，这两支邻近的3A球队将在“梦幻之地”进行小联盟对决。两队将身穿唤起1998年电影回忆的复古备用球衣。这场盛事也将充满天赋，包括2023年选秀第五顺位。外野手 Walker Jenkins（明尼苏达双城第1号新秀/MLB第14号）是一名潜在的五拍子球员，拥有突出的力量。Iowa 的阵容由最近升上的左右开弓捕手 Owen Ayers（芝加哥小熊第2号新秀）领衔，他凭借出色的本垒板纪律和原始力量，在小联盟 OPS 排行榜上名列前茅。
星期三

6:30 p.m. ET：Winston-Salem Dash (CWS) 对阵 Greensboro Grasshoppers (PIT)。Roch Cholowsky 正在展现他为何在七月的选秀中以第一顺位被选中。在为高阶1A Winston-Salem 效力的前四场比赛中，这位 UCLA 明星共击出五支安打（包括一支本垒打）、七分打点、两分得分和三次保送。Cholowsky 拥有多项上乘工具，他将在白袜附属球队对阵 Greensboro 以及强力青少年打者 Edward Florentino（匹兹堡海盗第2号新秀/MLB第28号）时，延续自己的良好第一印象。Florentino 于2024年从多米尼加共和国签约，这位身高6英尺3英寸的外野手是七名击出19支以上本垒打的青少年之一。
星期四

7:35 p.m. ET：Chattanooga Lookouts (CIN) 对阵 Montgomery Biscuits (TB)。本赛季很少有球员能像 Theo Gillen（坦帕湾光芒第1号新秀/MLB第9号）这样提升自己的价值。这位2024年首轮秀在本周开始前，所有进攻数据均创生涯新高，包括本垒打（20）、盗垒（39）和 OPS（1.007）。他利用速度与力量的结合，频频击出长打。与 Gillen 共同出现在阵容中的还有另一位进攻力量，左右开弓的捕手 Caden Bodine（坦帕湾光芒第3号新秀/MLB第90号），他擅长将球扎实地击成平飞球。带领2A Chattanooga 的是内野手 Cam Collier（辛辛那提红人第12号新秀）和 Carlos Sanchez（辛辛那提红人第13号新秀）。Collier 在2022年首轮被选中，拥有惊人的原始力量。Sanchez 则以其选择性好球带和高击球率著称。
订阅 MLB Pipeline 电子报
星期五

7 p.m. ET：Chesapeake Baysox (BAL) 对阵 Reading Fightin Phils (PHI)。在为新东家效力的首场比赛中，金莺队在交易截止日得到的 Anthony Eyanson（巴尔的摩金莺第1号新秀/MLB第49号）在2A Chesapeake 的比赛中，投五局失两分，飙出九次三振。他的第二次先发会带来什么？这位21岁的右投手拥有精英级别的旋转率，将面对另一位百大投手 Gage Wood（费城费城人第1号新秀/MLB第48号）。这位2025年首轮秀的四缝线快速球评分为70级，已能在“大联盟”立足，并且是小联盟中最顶级的球种之一。此役中另一名2025年选秀球员是 Wehiwa Aloy（巴尔的摩金莺第5号新秀）——2025年 Golden Spikes 奖得主。Aloy 在高阶1A的84场比赛中轰出15支本垒打，打击三围 .300/.371/.503，之后最近被升上来。
星期六

4:05 p.m. ET：Buffalo Bisons (TOR) 对阵 Worcester Red Sox (BOS)。自7月25日升上3A Worcester 以来，Franklin Arias（波士顿红袜第1号新秀/MLB第7号）在得点圈有跑者时势不可挡。这位活力四射的20岁球员——兼具上乘防守、犀利的击球工具和隐藏的长打能力——在新的级别前12场比赛中，以15支安打击出14分打点和三支本垒打。与 Arias 同场竞技的是 Sean Keys（多伦多蓝鸟第5号新秀），一名强壮的內野手，本季曾在大联盟出赛，各项工具均衡扎实。
星期日

1:05 p.m. ET：South Bend Cubs (CHC) 对阵 Great Lakes Loons (LAD)。力量、速度、打击。高阶1A Great Lakes 的三名百大新秀是小联盟中最具活力的组合之一。领衔的是外野手 Eduardo Quintero（洛杉矶道奇第3号新秀/MLB第19号），他在本周开始前以37次盗垒和 .931 的 OPS 领跑球队体系。Emil Morales（洛杉矶道奇第4号新秀/MLB第24号）拥有小联盟游击手中最出色的长打能力之一，而 Charles Davalan（洛杉矶道奇第6号新秀/MLB第81号）在过去几周找到了新的状态，本月前六场比赛中五场多安打。对决的另一边是 Josiah Hartshorn（芝加哥小熊第1号新秀/MLB第60号）。这位19岁的左右开弓打者于去年第六轮被选中，左右两侧都有强大的长打火力，并以92分打点领先小熊所有小联盟球员。

8 p.m. ET：Arkansas Travelers (SEA) 对阵 Tulsa Drillers (LAD)。这场2A对决中，两名百大新秀成为焦点。Josue De Paula（洛杉矶道奇第1号新秀/MLB第4号）和 Mike Sirota（洛杉矶道奇第2号新秀/MLB第11号）的强力球棒支撑着 Tulsa 的阵容。两人都善于击出安打和上垒，采用选择性挥棒，然后对好球带内的球全力出击。Arkansas 这边，敏捷的左右开弓游击手 Felnin Celesten（西雅图水手第3号新秀/MLB第36号）和飞毛腿外野手 Jonny Farmelo（西雅图水手第6号新秀/MLB第59号）站在最前沿。这对组合在横扫高阶1A西北联盟后最近被升了上来。

items.titleEn: Bateman proving to be 'a dude,' helps Blue Jays stay hot in win over Sox
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays just keep holding the line, suddenly playing a scrappy and stubborn brand of baseball.

Tuesday’s 5-3 win over the Red Sox wasn’t pretty, but we’re long past aesthetics here. The Blue Jays need wins any way they can find them, and with four in their last five games, this team is quietly building some momentum.
This is what mattered most:
1. Brett Bateman, you’re up
If you hit, you’re going to play. If you hit in big spots, get ready to be in that lineup 41 more times.

Brett Bateman is doing just that since coming over from the Cubs in the Kevin Gausman deal, so John Schneider keeps trusting him. With a single, double and two RBIs Tuesday, Bateman was one of the most important players on the field, and if he keeps contributing offensively while playing a solid center field, he may just stick near the top of the Blue Jays’ lineup, too.
The outfield is wide open in 2027, too, especially in center. This is officially an audition, and Bateman is making a fine first impression.
2. For the first time in a long time, Cease had to grind

By now, we’ve learned not to worry about velocity dips with Dylan Cease. We went through this same learning curve with Gausman, who would have dips that even he couldn’t explain, but still find a way out of it. Cease’s numbers were down about 2 mph across the board Tuesday night, and while there’s no need to worry about any health issues, it still isn’t ideal.

This led to long innings, something Cease has done very well to avoid lately. The fourth inning dragged on and on, demanding 31 pitches out of Cease, and the very first pitch of the next frame was sent over the wall in dead center by Ceddanne Rafaela.

Cease hadn’t fallen short of six innings since June 27, and in the six starts he’d made since then, he was averaging just over seven innings per appearance. That’s the sweet spot and a truly rare combination, pairing his elite swing-and-miss stuff with an ability to work deep into games.

This all carries weight in the Cy Young race, too. Because Dylan Cease missed a couple of weeks with the left hamstring injury he suffered in late May, Cease’s innings total (131 1/3) still trails that of Cam Schlittler, who leads the AL with 146 2/3. Cease’s strikeout numbers are overwhelming, but in this very tight race, Schlittler can make the case of owning a lower ERA (2.21 to Cease’s 2.40) over more innings.
3. The postseason? ‘It’s still realistic’

What’s done is done. The Blue Jays have left themselves a steep hill to climb, but there’s no changing that now. All they can do is win each series and slowly reel teams in over the next month, so this is another good start.

This is the stretch where it needs to happen, too. After this four-game series against the Red Sox, they host the Yankees, then hit the road to face the Rays and Yankees again next week. There’s no time to just “survive” a brutal schedule, they need to win.

“We know who we’re playing, we know how we have to play and I like the way we’re playing right now,” Schneider said. “I wish we were scoring a bit more to give the bullpen a break, but these guys are playing their asses off right now. It’s still realistic. I still think we’re a good team. We haven’t done as well as we would have hoped, but we’ve got time to do that.”
The time’s running out, but it hasn’t hit zero. If the Blue Jays can keep scraping together nights like this, they’ll keep outrunning it.
items.titleZh: 贝特曼证明自己是“狠角色”，助蓝鸟胜红袜延续火热
items.summaryZh: 贝特曼证明自己，助蓝鸟胜红袜延续火热；Cease虽遇挑战，球队仍相信季后赛机会。
bodyZh: 多伦多——蓝鸟就是能稳住阵脚，突然间打出了顽强又固执的棒球风格。
周二以5-3击败红袜的比赛并不华丽，但在这个阶段，我们已经顾不上美感了。蓝鸟需要任何能到手的胜利，最近5场比赛赢下4场，这支球队正在悄然积累势头。
以下几点最为关键：
1. Brett Bateman，轮到你了
如果你能打出安打，你就能上场。如果你能在关键时刻打出安打，那就准备好再进先发阵容41次吧。
Brett Bateman自通过Kevin Gausman交易从小熊转会而来后，正是这样做的，所以John Schneider持续信任他。周二他打出一垒安打、二垒安打和2分打点，成为场上最重要的球员之一。如果他能在进攻端继续做出贡献，同时在中外野防守稳健，他也可能稳居蓝鸟打线前段。
2027年的外野位置同样开放，尤其是中外野。这正式成为一场试镜，而Bateman留下了出色的第一印象。
2. 许久以来首次，Cease不得不苦撑
到目前为止，我们已经学会不为Dylan Cease的球速下滑而担心。我们在Gausman身上经历过同样的学习过程，他的球速有时连他自己都无法解释，但总能找到办法摆脱困境。周二晚上，Cease的各项球速数值全面下降约2英里/小时，虽然无需担心健康问题，但这仍不理想。
这导致了一些漫长的局数，而Cease近期一直很好地避免了这种情况。第四局持续拉长，消耗了Cease 31球，紧接着下一局的第一球就被Ceddanne Rafaela送上了中外野最深处的墙外。
自6月27日以来，Cease还从未投不满六局，而在这之后出战的6场先发中，他平均每场投超过七局。这是一个甜蜜点，也是一种真正罕见的组合，将他的顶级挥空球球威和投长局数的能力结合在一起。
这一切在赛扬奖竞争中也有分量。由于Dylan Cease因5月底左腿筋受伤缺席了几周，Cease的投球局数（131 1/3）仍落后于以146 2/3局领跑美国联盟的Cam Schlittler。Cease的三振数据令人震撼，但在这场极为胶着的竞争中，Schlittler可以凭借更多局数中更低的自责分率（2.21对Cease的2.40）来作为自己的论据。
3. 季后赛？“仍然现实”
木已成舟。蓝鸟给自己留下了一座陡峭的山峰要攀爬，但现在已无法改变。他们能做的就是赢下每个系列赛，在接下来的一个月里慢慢追上其他球队，因此这又是另一个好的开始。
现在也正需要在这个阶段发力。在与红袜的四场系列赛之后，他们将主场迎战洋基，然后下周客场对阵光芒和洋基。没有时间去“熬过”严酷的赛程，他们必须赢球。
“我们知道对手是谁，我们知道该怎么打，而且我喜欢我们现在的打球方式，”Schneider说。“我希望我们能多得一些分，让牛棚喘口气，但这些家伙现在真的在拼命打球。这仍然现实。我仍然认为我们是一支好球队。我们还没有做到我们希望的那样，但我们还有时间做到。”
时间所剩不多，但尚未归零。如果蓝鸟能继续拼下这样的夜晚，他们就能继续跑赢时间。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: Last night's 4th-out ruling was weird. But it gets even weirder ...
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays would like to have a normal day at the ballpark Tuesday. No stoppages in play, no calls to New York, no rule books and no fourth outs.

Monday’s ruling against the Red Sox, which allowed a Boston run to hit the board 15 minutes after the inning had ended, was still dominating conversations 18 hours later. Those who knew Rule 5.09(c)(4) spoke as if they’d been waiting 50 years to pull out this obscure fact. Those who do not hold a doctorate in the official rules of Major League Baseball were still shaking their head.
The Blue Jays have the luxury of laughing about it because they won.

The most incredible thing about Monday’s game was not the ruling itself, the rarity of that play or the spectacle it turned into… it’s the fact that John Schneider spent a good 15 minutes on the field without getting ejected.
“I actually asked [Blue Jays general manager] Ross [Atkins] for a cash advance for not getting thrown out yesterday,” Schneider joked.

Schneider reiterated that “the rule is the rule” and said that the umpiring crew explained it to the best of their ability, communicating honestly with the Blue Jays and Red Sox dugouts throughout. Schneider didn’t agree with how the ruling was handled and still insisted that his defenders had not “left the field of play” -- which negated their ability to make the necessary appeal to third base -- but that’s all water under the bridge.

It was actually Tuesday’s first-base umpire, Nestor Ceja, who knew the rule off the top of his head after running into it a few years back. Schneider was primarily dealing with crew chief Chris Guccione, though, who you saw address the crowd multiple times.

“Guccione actually said, ‘Do whatever you’ve got to do, man. If you’ve got to get mad, I’m not going to hold it against you,’” Schneider said. “And I thought… I’m managing a two-man bullpen right now, I’ve got to stay in this game.”

The “apparent fourth out” is a thing of legend, an obscure rule few have lived through. Ernie Clement said he’d never seen that rule in a game, but noted that Max Scherzer has. Of course he has. This is Scherzer’s 19th season in the big leagues.
“Max has seen that play before because he’s 42 and he’s seen everything,” Schneider said.

This actually happened in a game between the D-backs and Dodgers during Scherzer’s second season in MLB. Scherzer was in the D-backs' dugout with Dan Haren on the mound for Arizona. Haren snagged a comeback liner and threw to second base for the double play, but since that second out came on a tag, the apparent fourth out entered the picture and allowed the run to score from third.

It gets even wilder, though. Schneider himself had a link to this play, which was flagged by Jesse Goldberg-Strassler, broadcaster of the Lansing Lugnuts. In 2016, the Lugnuts were the Single-A affiliate of the Blue Jays and managed by a young Schneider when the same type of play -- and ruling -- landed in the middle of a game.
A decade and several jobs later, this was news to Schneider.
“I literally had no idea. I try to block out some of those days,” Schneider joked. “Apparently it was against Fort Wayne, I was told? I wasn’t thinking about that last night, no.”
If everything goes the way the Blue Jays hope, Schneider won’t go to bed thinking about the MLB rule book Tuesday night, either.
items.titleZh: 昨晚的“第四出局”判罚很怪，但还有更怪的……
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟昨日罕见“第四出局”判罚引热议，主帅施奈德差点被罚出场，还与一段旧事相关。
bodyZh: 多伦多——蓝鸟队希望周二在球场能度过正常的一天。没有比赛中断，没有呼叫纽约，没有规则手册，也没有第四出局。
周一针对红袜队的判罚，让波士顿的一分在局间结束后15分钟才上记分牌，这件事在18小时后仍是人们讨论的焦点。那些知道规则5.09(c)(4)的人说得好像他们等了50年才拿出这个冷门知识。而那些没有MLB官方规则博士学位的人仍在摇头。
蓝鸟队因为赢了球，所以有资本对此一笑置之。
周一比赛最不可思议的并不是判罚本身，不是那种回合的罕见程度，也不是它演变成的闹剧……而是John Schneider在场上待了整整15分钟却没有被驱逐出场。
Schneider开玩笑说：“我昨天真的向[蓝鸟总经理]Ross [Atkins]预支了现金，因为我没有被罚出场。”
Schneider重申“规则就是规则”，并表示裁判组尽其所能进行了解释，始终与蓝鸟和红袜的休息区坦诚沟通。Schneider不同意判罚的处理方式，仍然坚称他的防守球员没有“离开比赛场地”——这使他们失去了向三垒进行必要申诉的能力——但这些都已是过眼云烟。
实际上，是周二的一垒裁判Nestor Ceja在几年前遇到过这条规则后，才能脱口而出。不过，Schneider主要打交道的是裁判长Chris Guccione，你在场上多次看到他向人群讲话。
Schneider说：“Guccione实际上说，‘你想怎么做就怎么做吧，伙计。如果你想发火，我不会记恨。’我当时想……我现在指挥的是一个只有两人的牛棚，我必须留在比赛中。”
“明显的第四出局”是一个传奇，一条很少有人经历过的晦涩规则。Ernie Clement说他从未在比赛中见过这条规则，但指出Max Scherzer见过。他当然见过。这是Scherzer在大联盟的第19个赛季。
Schneider说：“Max以前见过那种情况，因为他42岁了，什么都见过。”
这实际上发生在Scherzer在大联盟的第二个赛季，响尾蛇对阵道奇的一场比赛中。当时Scherzer在响尾蛇的休息区，Dan Haren为亚利桑那登板投球。Haren接住了一记反弹平飞球，传向二垒完成双杀，但由于第二个出局是触杀，明显的第四出局就出现了，使得三垒跑者得以跑回本垒得分。
不过，这甚至更离奇。Schneider本人与这一回合有联系，这是兰辛螺母队（Lansing Lugnuts）的播音员Jesse Goldberg-Strassler指出的。2016年，Lugnuts是蓝鸟的1A级附属球队，由年轻的Schneider执教，当时同样的回合和判罚出现在一场比赛中。
十年后，经历了几份工作之后，这对Schneider来说还是新闻。
Schneider开玩笑说：“我真的不知道。我尽量忘掉那些日子。据说对手是韦恩堡？我昨晚可没想这个，没有。”
如果一切按蓝鸟希望的方向发展，Schneider周二晚上也不会在入睡前想着MLB规则手册。

items.titleEn: Yesavage has surgery on left knee, could still return this season
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Trey Yesavage underwent surgery on his left knee to repair his meniscus, cleaning up an injury he suffered recently in Houston.
Even here in August, the Blue Jays aren’t closing the door on Yesavage returning in 2026, either.
“He’s week to week. We’re not ruling him out for the year,” manager John Schneider said.

Yesavage injured his knee warming up for an inning against the Astros on Aug. 4, reporting a pinching feeling and that he wasn’t fully able to stabilize his knee. This is Yesavage’s lead leg down the mound, needed for a strong base in his delivery.

The Blue Jays will need to let Yesavage focus on rehabbing in the short term, but by the end of September, they’ll need to get a sense for whether they’ll be pushing him to ramp up for the stretch run or easing him off. The Blue Jays’ place in the standings matters here, too, as they’ll likely need to remain involved in the AL Wild Card race if they are going to speed up Yesavage’s timeline.

“In the next couple of weeks, we’ll know,” Schneider said. “The meniscus is weird. Sometimes, it can be fairly quick depending on how the person responds to it. I don’t want to say I’m ‘very optimistic,’ but I like the fact it’s not the year. We know he’s going to get back to throwing again.”

This is just another injury in a long, frustrating season for the Blue Jays. On top of Cody Ponce, José Berríos and Bowden Francis being lost for the year, the Blue Jays have also gone extended stretches without Shane Bieber and Max Scherzer. In Monday’s series opener against the Red Sox, Jameson Taillon left his start with an injury, too, and was placed on the 15-day IL Tuesday with right forearm tendinitis.

In Spring Training, we spent so much time talking about the Blue Jays having too many starting pitchers, and that storyline was quickly forgotten. Even last week, Toronto planned to pivot to a six-man rotation and had Spencer Arrighetti working his way back from a nerve issue in his foot as a seventh option, but that conversation has changed again.

“It doesn’t last very long,” Schneider joked. “It’s tough. Usually, you’re going through it once. When you’re going through it sporadically, it seems like injuries are happening in bunches or you get someone, then you lose someone. This is tough, but you’ve got to get creative. It taxes the bullpen, for sure, but you’ve got to figure out a way to do it. If it’s guys here, great. If it’s guys who aren’t here right now who need to step in for some innings, great.”

Simeon Woods Richardson is one option to take the vacant spot in the Blue Jays’ rotation along with some combination of Lazaro Estrada, Chad Dallas and CJ Van Eyk, who are all capable of starting but have worked in bulk roles with the big club. Righty John Klein, acquired from the Twins in the Jeff Hoffman deal, could be another option.

There’s no replacing Yesavage, though. His 2025 debut set the bar unreasonably high, but he’s still posted a 3.65 ERA over 93 2/3 innings. Returning in ‘26, even if it’s only briefly, will help to build Yesavage’s workload and give him a better baseline to approach 180-plus innings in ‘27.
items.titleZh: 耶塞维奇接受左膝手术，本赛季仍可能复出
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟新秀耶塞维奇接受左膝手术，有望本赛季回归。
bodyZh: 多伦多——特雷·耶塞维奇接受了左膝手术，修复半月板，清理了他最近在休斯敦受的伤。
即便到了八月，蓝鸟也没有关闭耶塞维奇在2026年回归的大门。
主教练约翰·施奈德表示：“他目前是逐周观察状态。我们不会排除他赛季报销的可能性。”
耶塞维奇在8月4日对阵太空人的比赛中，为投一局进行热身时伤到膝盖，他报告说膝盖有挤压感，并且无法完全稳定膝盖。这是耶塞维奇投球时的支撑腿，需要为他的投球动作提供稳固的基础。
短期内，蓝鸟需要让耶塞维奇专注于康复，但到9月底，他们需要判断是要推动他加速恢复以备战季后赛冲刺，还是让他慢慢恢复。蓝鸟在积分榜上的位置也很关键，因为他们如果打算加快耶塞维奇的恢复进度，很可能需要继续保持在美联外卡竞争行列。
施奈德说：“接下来几周我们就会知道。半月板问题很微妙。有时候，取决于球员的反应，恢复可能会相当快。我不想说我‘非常乐观’，但我喜欢这不是赛季报销的事实。我们知道他会重新回到投球状态。”
对于蓝鸟来说，这只是漫长而令人沮丧的赛季中又一次伤病。除了Cody Ponce、José Berríos和Bowden Francis赛季报销之外，蓝鸟还经历了Shane Bieber和Max Scherzer长期缺阵。在周一与红袜的系列赛揭幕战中，Jameson Taillon也在比赛中因伤退场，并于周二因右前臂肌腱炎被列入15天伤病名单。
在春训期间，我们花了很多时间讨论蓝鸟先发投手太多的问题，而这一话题很快就被遗忘了。甚至在上一周，多伦多还计划转向六人轮值，并让Spencer Arrighetti（脚部神经问题）作为第七选项逐步复出，但这一讨论又发生了变化。
施奈德开玩笑说：“这种安排持续不了太久。这很艰难。通常，你会经历一次。当你断断续续经历时，伤病似乎会扎堆出现，或者你刚有人复出，又有人倒下。这很艰难，但你必须创造性应对。这确实给牛棚带来了压力，但你必须想办法解决。如果现有球员能顶上，那很好。如果需要有现在不在队里的球员来承担一些局数，那也很好。”
Simeon Woods Richardson是填补蓝鸟轮值空缺的一个选择，还有Lazaro Estrada、Chad Dallas和CJ Van Eyk的组合，他们都有能力先发，但在大联盟球队中担任过长局数后援。右投John Klein，在Jeff Hoffman交易中从双城获得，可能也是另一个选择。
不过，没有人能取代耶塞维奇。他在2025年的首秀设定了过高的标准，但他仍然在93又2/3局中交出了3.65自责分率的表现。即使2026年只能短暂回归，也将有助于耶塞维奇增加投球负荷，并为他在2027年达到180局以上打下更好的基础。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays place Taillon (right forearm tendinitis) on IL, recall Chase Lee
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Jameson Taillon hit the 15-day injured list with right forearm tendinitis on Tuesday, a day after leaving his Blue Jays home debut early after just four innings. It is yet another blow to a rotation that cannot escape them.

Taillon was cruising against the Red Sox, too, which adds some salt to the wound. After a pair of walks in the first, Taillon had settled in nicely and allowed just one base hit on a chopper to third base. Following the fourth inning, though, there was a quick conversation in the dugout and Simeon Woods Richardson quickly began to warm in the bullpen.
Taillon’s velocity dipped noticeably in the fourth inning, his hardest pitch being a four-seamer that topped out at 90.1 mph.

“He said his forearm was a little tight getting some extension on cutters and sliders,” Blue Jays manager John Schneider said after the 2-1 win. “For a guy with an injury history, hopefully we can be proactive, and I don’t want to take any chances with him. He’s going to get an MRI and check it out, so we’ll know more tomorrow and we’re hoping for the best. He was throwing the ball well.”

Taillon was acquired from the Cubs at the Trade Deadline, a minor move for the veteran who’d just been designated for assignment in the middle of a difficult season. Taillon represented a very sensible candidate to fill innings down the stretch, though, and there were reasons to believe in a short-term bounce-back from Taillon, whom the Blue Jays had serious interest in four years ago before he signed in Chicago.

This unfortunately falls in line with a cruel injury trend that this rotation hasn’t been able to shake in 2026. Coming into Spring Training, it looked like the Blue Jays had too many starting pitchers. Since then, this is what’s piled up:
Cody Ponce: Torn right ACL
José Berríos: Tommy John surgery
Shane Bieber: Right elbow inflammation, missed first 78 games
Trey Yesavage: Right meniscus injury
Max Scherzer: Right forearm, left ankle and back injuries
Patrick Corbin: Left teres major strain
Bowden Francis: Tommy John surgery

The Blue Jays’ bullpen has taken the brunt of this, which has really shown in recent days. Woods Richardson was brought up to protect against spots just like this, when multiple innings may be needed, and the Blue Jays could continue to churn through their depth options as they make every effort to protect the already heavy workloads of regulars like Mason Fluharty, Braydon Fisher, Tyler Rogers and Louis Varland.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟将泰隆列入伤病名单，召回蔡斯·李
items.summaryZh: 泰隆因右前臂肌腱炎进入15日伤病名单。
bodyZh: 多伦多 -- 詹姆斯·泰隆周二因右前臂肌腱炎进入15日伤病名单，此前一天他在蓝鸟主场首秀中仅投四局便提前离场。这对本就伤病缠身的先发轮值而言又是一次打击。
泰隆对阵红袜时表现顺风顺水，这更令人惋惜。首局两次保送后，泰隆迅速进入状态，仅因三垒方向的一记滚地球被打出一支安打。然而第四局结束后，休息区进行了简短交流，西缅·伍兹·理查德森随即开始在牛棚热身。
泰隆在第四局的球速明显下降，他最快的四缝线速球仅达90.1英里/小时。
“他说投切球和滑球时前臂有些紧绷，”蓝鸟主帅约翰·施奈德在2-1获胜后表示。“对于有伤病史的球员，希望我们能主动应对，我不想冒任何风险。他将接受核磁共振检查，明天会有更多消息，我们期待最好的结果。他之前投得不错。”
泰隆是在交易截止日从小熊队获得的，对于这位在困难赛季中刚被指定转移的老将来说，这是一笔小操作。泰隆是填补后续局数的非常合理人选，而且有理由相信他能短期反弹——蓝鸟四年前在他签约芝加哥之前就对他有浓厚兴趣。
遗憾的是，这延续了2026年轮值无法摆脱的残酷伤病趋势。春训开始时，蓝鸟似乎在先发投手方面人手过剩。此后，伤病名单不断累积：
科迪·庞斯：右膝前交叉韧带撕裂
何塞·贝里奥斯：汤米·约翰手术
肖恩·比伯：右肘炎症，缺席前78场比赛
特雷·耶萨维奇：右半月板损伤
马克斯·谢泽尔：右前臂、左踝和背部伤势
帕特里克·科尔宾：左大圆肌拉伤
鲍登·弗朗西斯：汤米·约翰手术
蓝鸟的牛棚承受了大部分压力，这在近几日尤为明显。伍兹·理查德森被升上来正是为了应对这种可能需要多局投球的情况。蓝鸟将继续轮换深度选项，竭尽全力保护梅森·弗拉哈蒂、布雷登·费舍尔、泰勒·罗杰斯和路易斯·瓦兰德等常规投手本已繁重的工作量。

items.titleEn: Rule check: Red Sox-Blue Jays delayed for unusual run-scoring play
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Did that run count? How many outs were there? What on earth just happened?

For 15 minutes following the end of the top of the seventh Monday night at Rogers Centre, that’s what everyone in the Blue Jays' and Red Sox's dugouts were asking. Depending on which dugout you were in, you had different answers. Here’s the scene, step by step, which led to the chaos:

The first play: With runners on first and second and no outs, Nick Sogard shot a hard, low liner to Vladimir Guerrero Jr. at first base. The ball hit the ground, though, and he threw to second for the first out of the inning, allowing Sogard to stay at first and Anthony Seigler to advance to third. The Red Sox were down 2-0 at this point, pressing to get back into the game.
The confusion: The scoreboard displayed two outs, and the play was also announced to the media as a double play at the time.

The final play: Ceddanne Rafaela flew out to center field, but there seemed to be confusion among players on both sides about whether that was the second or third out. Brett Bateman lobbed the ball back in, which eventually made it to first base, where Vladdy tagged the bag.
It felt like something was… off?

This is when the meetings began between the umpiring crew and each manager. The players were getting involved, too, with Max Scherzer eager to share his opinion on the matter from the Blue Jays’ dugout. The question at the center of the confusion was whether the runner from third scored, and whether that run would ultimately count. This was especially confusing on a play where some players seemed to be under different impressions about the number of outs.

“What we have here is we have a time play,” crew chief Chris Guccione announced to the crowd, “meaning when the third out was made at first base with the runner not tagging up, the runner that was on third base also did not tag but crossed home plate before the third out was made at first base. So we're going to New York to do a rules check."
After checking in with the replay review crew in New York, the umpiring crew huddled once more with each manager and Guccione again addressed the crowd and television audience.
"After calling New York and getting it all straightened out, the run is going to score,” Guccione said. “End of the inning. Two runs for Toronto, one run for Boston."
Ultimately, the ruling didn’t impact the outcome of the game, which the Blue Jays won, 2-1, to open the series.
items.titleZh: 规则核查：红袜对蓝鸟因罕见得分争议中断比赛
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟对红袜比赛中出现罕见的得分争议，裁判经回放审查后认定得分有效。
bodyZh: 多伦多——这一分算不算？当时是几出局？刚才到底发生了什么？
周一晚在罗杰斯中心，七局上半结束后，蓝鸟和红袜的休息区里，所有人都为此困惑了整整15分钟。你身处哪个休息区，就会得到不同的答案。以下是引发混乱的场景的逐步还原：
第一幕：一垒有人、二垒有人、无人出局，Nick Sogard击出一记又平又低的直线球，飞向一垒的Vladimir Guerrero Jr.。不过球落在了地上，Guerrero将球传向二垒，完成本局第一个出局，Sogard留在一垒，Anthony Seigler推进到三垒。此时红袜以0比2落后，急于追回比分。
混乱之处：记分牌显示两出局，当时这一防守动作也向媒体播报为双杀。
最后一位：Ceddanne Rafaela击出中外野飞球出局，但双方球员似乎都对这是第二出局还是第三出局感到困惑。Brett Bateman将球传回内场，最终球传至一垒，Vladdy踩踏一垒垒包。
感觉哪里不对劲？
这时裁判组开始与双方总教练进行商讨。球员们也参与了进来，Max Scherzer在蓝鸟休息区里急切地分享自己的看法。混乱的核心问题是：三垒上的跑者是否得分，以及这一分最终是否有效。在部分球员似乎对出局数有不同认知的情况下，这一分尤其令人困惑。
“我们遇到的是一个时间性得分（time play）的情况，”主审裁判Chris Guccione向观众宣布，“也就是说，当一垒完成第三出局时，跑者没有回垒踩垒包，而在第三出局于二垒形成前，原本在三垒的跑者也没有踩垒包，但已经跨过本垒板。所以我们将跟纽约方面进行规则核查。”
在与纽约的回放审查组沟通后，裁判组再次与双方总教练聚在一起，Guccione再次向观众和电视观众说明。
“在致电纽约并理清所有情况后，这一分将算作有效，”Guccione说，“本局结束。多伦多得两分，波士顿得一分。”
最终，这一判罚没有影响比赛结果，蓝鸟以2比1赢下了本场比赛，迎来系列赛开门红。

items.titleEn: McAdoo's second MLB homer shows Schneider's willingness to ride hot hand
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays are going to make this interesting, aren’t they?

With another win Monday night, 2-1, to open their series against the Red Sox, the Blue Jays carried over some momentum from their recent 4-3 road trip. It’s still a steep hill to climb, given all of the teams stacked up in front of them in the AL Wild Card race, but this team is finally playing some better baseball.
Monday’s game featured a long, confusing break for a ruling, too, in which the Red Sox were awarded a run in the top of the seventh inning … nearly 15 minutes after the inning had ended.
From Monday’s win, this is what mattered most:
1. You hit? You play.

Charles McAdoo’s solo home run off Sonny Gray got the Blue Jays on the board in the fifth, and at this point of the season, manager John Schneider is willing to ride the hot hand. We’ve even seen that with rookie Brett Bateman, who’s getting looks at the top of the lineup.

What the Blue Jays have done through their first 120 games on offense hasn’t worked. There seems to be an openness to trying new configurations after the Trade Deadline, and for young players like McAdoo, that’s great news.

The only shortcut the Blue Jays have back into the playoff race is power. McAdoo has 18 homers this season between Triple-A Buffalo (16) and Toronto (2), which is a fine start. He was a late addition to Monday’s lineup to replace Kazuma Okamoto (knee contusion), but that one swing earned him more at-bats.
2. Who’s up next in the rotation?

Yes, we’ve all been forced to face this question a dozen times in 2026. This rotation has felt cursed, all of that incredible depth slowly chewed away by injuries. Now, with Kevin Gausman out the door to the Cubs, Spencer Arrighetti dealing with a nerve issue in his foot and Jameson Taillon leaving Monday’s start early with right forearm tightness, it’s time to ask again … who’s next?

Simeon Woods Richardson, who threw three innings of one-run ball Monday, could be first up. He’s a natural starter and had been working between three and five innings down in Triple-A Buffalo, which is a good enough baseline. Some combination of Lazaro Estrada, Chad Dallas and CJ Van Eyk could also be used, while righty John Klein -- acquired at the Deadline from the Twins in the Jeff Hoffman deal -- is another option.
A month or two ago, Spencer Miles would have been the easy answer. He’s already up to 75 innings, though, and the Blue Jays would prefer to keep him in a shortened role to finish the season.
3. Less is more
This team is right in the middle of 17 games in 17 days, the product of that one rescheduled game in Chicago against the Cubs last Thursday eating up what was once an off-day.

These days are a grind. The chaos of the Trade Deadline has passed, but we haven’t quite reached the adrenaline of September and the race for the postseason. These players have already spent 120 games together on top of Spring Training, long days and long nights the entire way. Right around now, Schneider and the staff need to find days to ease off.

“We did that on Saturday [in Philadelphia]. We showed up later before the game and we’re adjusting the work a little bit here and there,” Schneider said. “There will be some days mixed in, probably, where we do come in a little bit later. It’s about being smart with it. You don’t have to take ground balls every day and you don’t have to hit on the field every day. Save up your energy for the game.”
items.titleZh: 麦克阿杜第二轰，施奈德愿用状态火热的球员
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟2-1胜红袜，麦克阿杜轰出第二支大联盟本垒打；施奈德愿用状态火热的球员，但先发轮值再遭伤病打击。
bodyZh: 多伦多——蓝鸟队要让这件事变得有趣，不是吗？
周一晚上以2-1再胜一场，开启了对阵红袜的系列赛，蓝鸟队延续了最近4胜3负客场之旅的势头。考虑到美联外卡竞争中他们面前堆积的众多球队，这仍然是一座陡峭的山峰要攀登，但这支球队终于打出了更好的棒球。
周一的比赛还出现了一次漫长且令人困惑的裁决暂停，红袜队在第七局上半局被判得一分……而此时该局已结束近15分钟。
从周一的胜利来看，以下几点最重要：
1. 能打？就能上场。
查尔斯·麦克阿杜在第五局从桑尼·格雷手中轰出阳春本垒打，帮助蓝鸟队得分。在赛季的这个阶段，主教练约翰·施奈德愿意使用手感火热的球员。我们甚至在新秀布雷特·贝特曼身上看到了这一点，他正在打线顶端获得机会。
蓝鸟队在前120场比赛中的进攻表现并未奏效。交易截止日后，球队似乎对尝试新的阵容配置持开放态度，对于像麦克阿杜这样的年轻球员来说，这是好消息。
蓝鸟队重返季后赛竞争的捷径只有火力。麦克阿杜本赛季在3A水牛城（16轰）和多伦多（2轰）合计轰出18支本垒打，这是一个不错的开始。他是周一赛前临时加入阵容的，顶替了（膝盖挫伤的）Kazuma Okamoto，但那一挥棒为他赢得了更多打席。
2. 先发轮值中下一个是谁？
是的，在2026年，我们都不得不面对这个问题十几次了。这套先发轮值像是被诅咒了，原本惊人的阵容深度被伤病慢慢吞噬。如今，凯文·高斯曼离队加盟小熊，斯宾塞·阿里盖蒂正在处理脚部神经问题，詹姆斯·泰隆周一先发因右前臂紧张提前退场，是时候再次发问……下一个是谁？
西蒙·伍兹·理查森周一投了三局失一分，可能会是第一个顶上的人选。他是一名天然先发投手，在3A水牛城已经投了三到五局，这是一个足够好的基础。拉扎罗·埃斯特拉达、查德·达拉斯和CJ·范·艾克的某种组合也可能被使用，而右投手约翰·克莱因——在交易截止日通过杰夫·霍夫曼交易从双城获得——是另一个选择。
一两个月前，斯宾塞·迈尔斯会是个简单的答案。不过他已经投了75局，蓝鸟队更希望让他在本赛季剩余时间里担任缩短的角色。
3. 少即是多
球队正处于17天17赛的密集赛程中，这是上周四在芝加哥对阵小熊队的一场改期比赛消耗了原本休息日的结果。
这些日子是煎熬。交易截止日的混乱已经过去，但我们还没有完全迎来九月和季后赛争夺的肾上腺素激增。这些球员已经一起度过了120场比赛，加上春训，一路都是漫长的白天和黑夜。现在正是这个时候，施奈德和教练组需要找到一些日子来放松。
“我们在周六（在费城）就这么做了。赛前我们晚到了一些，我们正在这里那里调整训练安排，”施奈德说。“可能会有一些日子，大概，我们会晚一点来。要聪明地处理这件事。你不需要每天都接滚地球，也不需要在场上每天打击。把能量留到比赛中。”

items.titleEn: Pivotal stretch looming, Blue Jays ready to prove themselves
bodyEn: PHILADELPHIA -- As they prepared for their flight back to Toronto on Sunday evening, it was difficult to tell whether the Blue Jays had just won or lost.

Loud music echoed through a room filled with players both mentally and physically drained from yet another extra-innings affair, a sound typically reserved for a winning clubhouse. But even after falling to the Phillies in 12 innings Sunday, the Blue Jays were heading home with another series win and a winning record on their seven-game, three-city road trip, eager to continue their unlikely quest for a return to the postseason.

“There's nothing better than that, when you're getting into the dog days of August and down the stretch, there's nothing better than meaningful baseball,” manager John Schneider said after his team’s 7-6 loss to the Phillies at Citizens Bank Park. “If we can have the mentality, the intensity and the cohesiveness, everyone doing their part, I'll take my chances with these guys. You never know when a team kind of finds itself and turns the corner a little bit.”

On July 24, the Blue Jays sat at 47-57, 10 games under .500 and 6 1/2 games out of a postseason spot -- with five other teams standing between them and the Guardians, who held that third and final Wild Card position.

Over the next 10 days, general manager Ross Atkins threaded the buy/sell needle leading up to the Trade Deadline, shipping off Kevin Gausman, Daulton Varsho (both impending free agents) and Jeff Hoffman (under control through 2027) while acquiring José Soriano, Josh Smith, Spencer Arrighetti and Jameson Taillon, the first three of whom are under club control for at least two more years.

“We purposely kept guys here that we thought could help us win and purposely acquired guys that we thought could help us win this year and going forward,” Schneider said. “It wasn't a straight sell at the Deadline. It's not like, ‘Hey, let's look forward to 2027.’ We’ve got some games to play here.”
“Everybody still believes, from our front office all the way to our locker room,” George Springer said. “We're one good stretch away from being right where we want to be.”

That stretch begins Monday, when the Blue Jays open a four-game set at Rogers Centre against the red-hot Red Sox, winners of 27 of their last 32 games. After that, it’s a three-game set against the Yankees, followed by a six-game road trip to St. Petersburg and the Bronx.
“This could be our season,” Ernie Clement said. “If we play really, really well, it's going to put us in a great position. We're just going to show up every day and try to take care of business.”

The Blue Jays are 7-4 in their last 11 games after taking two of three in Philly, cutting their Wild Card deficit down to 3 1/2 games. Yes, there are still five teams in between Toronto and that third spot, but the Blue Jays have at least three games remaining against every team in front of them other than the Twins, giving them an opportunity to take care of their own business.

“We're playing with a lot of energy and playing like we’ve got nothing to lose at this point,” Clement said. “That's a dangerous team, the one that plays with nothing to lose. We feel really good about how we've been playing. We can't really look at the standings -- just go out there and take it day by day.”

Following this upcoming two-week AL East gauntlet, the Blue Jays have three games left against the Mariners, Guardians, Tigers and Rangers, with six remaining against the Orioles. Throw in six against the Royals and three each against the Athletics and Reds, and that’s what the Blue Jays have standing between themselves and a potential playoff spot.

“Those are obviously some really good teams who are playing extremely well,” Springer said. “I think everybody understands the task at hand and everybody understands that it's going to take all of us to get to where we want to go. It’s not an easy road, but I like the way that we've been playing.”

Schneider believes some of his players who have battled inconsistency this season “are starting to be a little bit more like themselves,” giving him the belief that the Blue Jays are capable of putting together the seven-week run necessary to get to the playoffs.
“It's kind of what we envisioned from the get-go,” Schneider said. “We’ve got to keep this rolling the rest of the way.”
items.titleZh: 关键阶段来临，蓝鸟蓄势待发迎来自我证明
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟队迎来关键赛程，全队上下信心满满。
bodyZh: 费城——周日晚，当多伦多蓝鸟队准备搭乘航班返回多伦多时，很难分辨他们刚刚是赢了还是输了。
喧闹的音乐回荡在房间里，球员们因又一场加时大战而身心俱疲，这种声音通常是胜利方更衣室才有的。然而，即便在周日以12局不敌费城人，蓝鸟队仍带着又一个系列赛胜利和七场三城客场之旅的胜多负少战绩回家，渴望继续他们重返季后赛的不寻常征程。
“没有什么比这更好了，当你进入八月最艰难的阶段和赛季冲刺期，没有什么比有意义的比赛更好了，”主教练John Schneider在球队于公民银行球场以7-6不敌费城人后表示。“如果我们能保持这种心态、强度和凝聚力，每个人都尽自己的一份力，我愿意和这些家伙一起赌一把。你永远不知道一支球队何时会找到自我并有所转折。”
7月24日，蓝鸟队战绩为47胜57负，低于五成胜率10场，距离季后赛席位差6个半胜场——在他们与守住第三个也是最后一个外卡席位的守护者队之间，还隔着五支球队。
接下来的10天里，总经理Ross Atkins在交易截止日前巧妙平衡了买卖操作，送走了Kevin Gausman、Daulton Varsho（两人均为即将成为自由球员）以及Jeff Hoffman（合同控制至2027年），同时引进了José Soriano、Josh Smith、Spencer Arrighetti和Jameson Taillon，其中前三人的俱乐部控制权至少还有两年。
“我们特意留下了那些我们认为能帮助我们赢球的球员，也特意引进了那些我们认为能在今年及未来帮助我们赢球的球员，”Schneider说。“这并非截止日时的彻底甩卖。不是说，‘嘿，让我们展望2027年吧。’我们还有比赛要打。”
“每个人都仍然相信，从管理层到我们的更衣室，”George Springer说。“我们距离理想状态只差一段出色的表现。”
这段表现从周一开始，届时蓝鸟队将在罗杰斯中心与状态火热的红袜队展开四连战，后者在过去32场比赛中赢下27场。之后是对阵洋基队的三连战，再之后是前往圣彼得堡和布朗克斯的六场客场之旅。
“这可能是我们的赛季关键期，”Ernie Clement说。“如果我们打得非常好，那将让我们处于绝佳位置。我们只需每天上场，努力完成任务。”
在客场对费城人取得三战两胜后，蓝鸟队最近11场战绩为7胜4负，将外卡差距缩小到3个半胜场。是的，多伦多与那个第三名之间仍有五支球队，但除了双城队之外，蓝鸟队对阵身前每支球队都至少还剩三场比赛，这给了他们自己掌控命运的机会。
“我们充满能量地打球，感觉就像到了这个阶段我们已经没有什么可失去的，”Clement说。“一支无所畏惧的球队是危险的。我们对自己的表现感觉非常好。我们不能太过关注排名——只要上场，一天天来。”
在即将到来的两周美联东区内战之后，蓝鸟队还将与水手队、守护者队、老虎队和游骑兵队各打三场，与金莺队还剩六场。再加上与皇家队的六场以及与运动家队和红人队各三场，这就是蓝鸟队通往潜在季后赛席位之路上的对手。
“这些显然都是打得非常好的强队，”Springer说。“我想每个人都理解眼前的任务，也都明白需要所有人共同努力才能到达我们想去的地方。这条路并不容易，但我喜欢我们一直以来的打球方式。”
Schneider认为，一些本赛季状态起伏的球员“开始更像他们自己了”，这让他相信蓝鸟队有能力打出晋级季后赛所需的七周好球。
“这是我们从一开始就设想的，”Schneider说。“我们必须在剩余比赛中保持这种势头。”

items.titleEn: 'The ultimate competitor': Mad Max passes Big Train with 3,516th career K
bodyEn: PHILADELPHIA – Move over, Big Train. Mad Max just put you in his rear-view mirror.

Max Scherzer passed Walter Johnson for sole possession of 10th place on Major League Baseball’s all-time strikeout list, recording the 3,516th punchout of his career with a sixth-inning K of Kyle Schwarber on Saturday night at Citizens Bank Park.

Scherzer entered Saturday’s start needing four strikeouts to pass Johnson, who pitched for the Washington Senators from 1907-1921, earning induction into the Hall of Fame’s inaugural class in 1936. Johnson’s career strikeout total is 3,515, according to Elias Sports Bureau, which is the official statistician of Major League Baseball.

Scherzer recorded his first strikeout in the opening frame, getting former Nationals teammate Bryce Harper on a 1-2 slider. The second came in the third inning, as Scherzer struck out Garrett Stubbs on three pitches, finishing him off with a curveball. Scherzer tied Johnson in the fifth with his 3,515th strikeout, getting Bryan De La Cruz on a check swing that first-base umpire Brock Ballou ruled a swing for strike three.
Scherzer’s milestone strikeout came in the bottom of the sixth, as he caught Schwarber looking at strike three to pass Johnson for 10th place.

It was only appropriate that Scherzer moved into the top 10 in Philadelphia, where he’s enjoyed some of his greatest success. The 42-year-old now has 255 career strikeouts against the Phillies – more than any other team he’s faced – while his 116 strikeouts are the most by a visiting pitcher at Citizens Bank Park since it opened in 2004.
Things took a turn for Scherzer following his historic strikeout, as Trea Turner and Harper hit back-to-back solo home runs, tying the game 2-2 before Scherzer was pulled for reliever Spencer Miles.

Scherzer ranks second to former teammate Justin Verlander among all active pitchers in wins and strikeouts, numbers that will see him land in Cooperstown five years after his magnificent career is complete.
Every member of the 3,000-strikeout club

“Just knowing him, the person, and kind of how he can be, you forget about the stuff that comes with him: the numbers, the strikeouts, the World Series, the Cy Youngs, all the stuff that comes with him, because he's still really, really competitive,” manager John Schneider said before the game. “That would be cool when we're talking top 10 anything in baseball. You’re lucky to be part of that – a small part of that – based on what he's done.”

Next up on the list for Scherzer: Hall of Famer Gaylord Perry, who ranks No. 9 with 3,534 strikeouts. Verlander is currently in the No. 8 spot at 3,554, while Don Sutton – another Hall of Famer – is No. 7 with 3,574.
items.titleZh: “终极竞争者”：麦克斯超越火车头，生涯第3516次三振
items.summaryZh: 谢泽尔生涯三振数超越约翰逊，升至历史第10。
bodyZh: 费城——火车头，请让一让。麦克斯刚刚把你甩在了身后。
麦克斯·谢泽尔在周六晚于市民银行球场第六局三振凯尔·施瓦伯，完成生涯第3516次三振，超越沃尔特·约翰逊，独占大联盟历史三振榜第10位。
谢泽尔在周六先发前还差4次三振就能超越约翰逊。约翰逊1907至1921年效力于华盛顿参议员队，1936年入选名人堂首届成员。据大联盟官方统计机构Elias Sports Bureau的数据，约翰逊生涯三振总数为3515次。
谢泽尔在首局就取得第一次三振，用一颗1-2滑球让前国民队友布莱斯·哈珀挥空出局。第二次三振出现在第三局，谢泽尔用三球三振加勒特·斯塔布斯，最后一球是曲线球。谢泽尔在第五局以第3515次三振追平约翰逊，让布莱恩·德拉克鲁兹挥棒过半，一垒裁判布洛克·巴卢判定挥棒，形成三振。
谢泽尔的里程碑三振出现在第六局下半，他让施瓦伯站着不动目送第三好球进垒，从而超越约翰逊升至第10位。
谢泽尔在费城跻身前10可谓是恰如其分，他曾在这里取得过一些最伟大的成就。这位42岁老将生涯面对费城人已累计255次三振——超过他面对的任何其他球队——而他在市民银行球场的116次三振也是自2004年球场开放以来客队投手在该球场的最多三振纪录。
在历史性三振之后，形势对谢泽尔急转直下，特雷·特纳和哈珀连续轰出阳春炮，将比分追成2-2平，随后谢泽尔被换下，改由后援投手斯宾塞·迈尔斯登板。
谢泽尔在现役投手中胜场数排名第二，仅次于前队友贾斯汀·维兰德，三振数同样位列第二。这些数据将让他在辉煌的职业生涯结束后五年进入库珀斯敦。
3000次三振俱乐部全体成员
“只要了解他这个人，以及他可能的样子，你就会忘记他附带的一切：数据、三振、世界大赛、赛扬奖，所有这些，因为他仍然非常非常有竞争力，”主教练约翰·施奈德赛前表示。“当我们谈论棒球史上任何一项前十排名时，那都很了不起。基于他做的一切，你能成为其中一分子——哪怕是很小的一部分——都很幸运。”
谢泽尔的下一个目标是名人堂成员盖洛德·佩里，他以3534次三振排名第9。维兰德目前以3554次三振位列第8，另一位名人堂成员唐·萨顿以3574次三振排名第7。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays' red-hot top prospect Parker promoted to High-A
bodyEn: The Blue Jays’ top prospect is moving up another level.

JoJo Parker, MLB Pipeline’s No. 1 Blue Jays prospect and No. 27 overall prospect in baseball, is being promoted to High-A Vancouver, according to MLB.com’s Keegan Matheson. Parker, who turned 20 years old on Saturday, had an .859 OPS with 13 home runs and 22 stolen bases in 87 games with Single-A Dunedin.

Parker’s promotion is hardly a surprise given the recent tear he’s been on. In a doubleheader for Dunedin on Friday, Parker recorded five hits, including a home run and a pair of doubles. Parker had two knocks in Game 1 on Friday and went 3-for-4 in Game 2 with a dinger and two doubles.

Parker, the No. 8 overall pick in the 2025 Draft, is the clear-cut shortstop of the future in Toronto, especially after the Blue Jays traded Arjun Nimmala to the Angels for starter José Soriano. While he just departed his teen years, Parker’s production and prospect pedigree mean we could see the talented shortstop make his mark in the Majors sooner rather than later.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟最炙手可热的新秀Parker升入高A
bodyZh: 蓝鸟队的顶级新秀又升一级。
据MLB.com的Keegan Matheson报道，MLB Pipeline蓝鸟队排名第一、全棒球第27位的JoJo Parker升入高A温哥华。Parker周六刚满20岁，在1A邓尼丁的87场比赛中，OPS为.859，击出13支本垒打，盗垒22次。
考虑到他最近的出色表现，Parker的升级并不令人意外。周五邓尼丁的双重赛中，Parker击出5支安打，包括一支本垒打和两支二垒安打。Parker在周五第一场比赛中击出2支安打，第二场4打数3安打，包括一支本垒打和两支二垒安打。
Parker是2025年选秀大会第8顺位新秀，是多伦多明确的未来游击手，尤其是在蓝鸟将Arjun Nimmala交易至天使换来先发投手José Soriano之后。虽然他刚刚告别青少年时期，但Parker的产出和新秀资历意味着我们可能很快就能看到这位才华横溢的游击手在大联盟留下印记。
items.author: Brent Maguire

items.titleEn: Blue Jays' top prospect enjoys 5-hit doubleheader amidst red-hot stretch
bodyEn: The hits just keep on coming for JoJo Parker.

The Blue Jays' top-ranked prospect continued his recent tear at the plate with a five-hit day -- including a home run and a pair of doubles -- across a Single-A doubleheader as Dunedin dropped Game 1 to Lakeland 11-1 before salvaging a split in the twinbill with a 6-0 blanking of the Flying Tigers in the nightcap at Publix Field at Joker Marchant Stadium on Friday.
Get tickets to a Minor League game near you »

After collecting a pair of knocks in Game 1 on Friday, Parker went 3-for-4 in Game 2 with a dinger and two doubles. It marked the 21st multihit performance of the 19-year-old's rookie campaign, fourth with at least three knocks and first with three extra-base hits. He also tied his season high with four RBIs.

After a scorching June in which MLB's No. 27 overall prospect slashed .297/.430/.662 with six homers, a pair of triples, five doubles, 20 RBIs and seven stolen bases in 21 games, Parker appeared to cool off a bit in July but has found his boomstick again of late. The 2025 No. 8 overall Draft pick is batting .483 (14-for-29) with a 1.600 OPS and four taters, a triple, three doubles, 14 RBIs and nine runs scored over his past seven games.

In the nightcap of his club's doubleheader on Friday, Parker opened the scoring with an RBI double down the first-base line off an 0-1 changeup from Tigers No. 10 prospect Malachi Witherspoon in the first inning. The Mississippi prep star stepped to the dish in the following frame and turned around a 95 mph heater from Witherspoon for a three-run jack -- his 13th long ball of the year.
In his final plate appearance of the day in the seventh, Parker sent a 105.8 mph laser to right off a breaking ball from right-hander Pedro Garcia.

The 6-foot-2, 200-pound shortstop ranks atop the Florida State League with 66 RBIs; his 24 doubles, 40 extra-base hits and 68 runs scored are second among the circuit. He also ranks among the top six with 24 doubles (third), 63 walks (third), 153 total bases (fifth) and a .388 OBP (fifth).

Parker entered the 2025 Draft as the Mississippi Gatorade Player of the Year and the Blue Jays signed him away from his Mississippi State commitment for slightly under slot at $6,197,500. After not getting into an official game after signing, Parker made his pro debut at Single-A this season.

His overall hitting ability and athleticism have always stood out. Parker has a powerful left-handed swing, but he’s shown the ability to keep his hacks under control, impressing scouts with his advanced strike zone awareness. Though he tended more toward line drives, there was already a feel to add loft in his swing and with his power stroke already beginning to show promise, there is the potential that he could get to plus power in the future.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟头号新秀在火热状态中双赛拿下五安打
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟头号新秀帕克在双赛中打出五支安打，含一轰和两支二垒安打。
bodyZh: 乔乔·帕克的安打还在不断涌现。
蓝鸟队排名第一的新秀延续了近期在打击区的火热手感，在1A双赛中单日打出五支安打——包括一支本垒打和两支二垒安打——但但尼丁在首战以1-11输给莱克兰，随后在周五于Joker Marchant球场的Publix球场进行的第二场比赛中以6-0完封飞行虎队，收获双赛的平分。
购票观看附近的小联盟比赛 »
在周五首战中打出两支安打后，帕克在第二场4打数3安打，包括一支本垒打和两支二垒安打。这是他19岁的新秀赛季第21次单场多安打，第4次至少三支安打，也是首次单场三支长打。他还追平了赛季单场最高的4分打点。

在炙手可热的六月，这位MLB第27号综合新秀在21场比赛中打出.297/.430/.662的打击三围，外加6支本垒打、2支三垒安打、5支二垒安打、20分打点和7次盗垒。进入七月后帕克似乎有所降温，但最近又重新找到了重炮手感。这位2025年选秀大会第8顺位新秀在过去七场比赛中打击率高达.483（29打数14安打），OPS为1.600，外加4支本垒打、1支三垒安打、3支二垒安打、14分打点和9分得分。
在周五双赛的第二场中，帕克首局从老虎队第10号新秀Malachi Witherspoon手中打出一支沿一垒线的二垒安打，打下1分打点，率先为球队得分。这位密西西比高中明星在下一局再次上场打击，将Witherspoon一颗95英里直球轰成三分炮——这是他本季第13支本垒打。
在第七局当天最后一次上场打击中，帕克从右投手Pedro Garcia手中打出一记击球初速105.8英里、飞向右外野的平飞球。
这位6英尺2英寸、200磅的游击手目前以66分打点领跑佛罗里达州联赛；他的24支二垒安打、40支长打和68分得分均排名联盟第二。他的24支二垒安打（第三）、63次保送（第三）、153个垒打数（第五）和.388上垒率（第五）也均位列前六。
帕克在进入2025年选秀时被评选为密西西比州佳得乐年度最佳球员，蓝鸟队以略低于签位价的6,197,500美元将他签下，使其放弃了对密西西比州立大学的承诺。签约后没有参加正式比赛，帕克本赛季直接在1A完成职业首秀。
他全面的打击能力和运动天赋一直很突出。帕克拥有强力的左打挥棒，但他展示出了控制挥棒的能力，其成熟的选球眼光给球探留下了深刻印象。虽然他更倾向于平飞球，但已经能感受到他在挥棒中增加仰角的意识，随着他的力量已经开始展现潜力，未来他有望发展出更高的长打威力。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays prospect Bateman barrels double off Wheeler in MLB debut
bodyEn: The Blue Jays added outfielder Brett Bateman to their active roster Friday, just five days after acquiring him from the Cubs as part of Monday’s Kevin Gasuman trade.

Bateman, the Blue Jays’ No. 20 prospect, played just two games in Toronto’s organization before getting his first callup to the big leagues. He went 2-for-8 with two singles and two walks for Triple-A Buffalo. On the year, the left-handed hitter is batting .311 with a .429 on-base percentage.

Bateman hasn't shown much power (six home runs in 317 pro games), but he has fantastic speed and contact ability; he has stolen 20 bases this year while recording nearly as many walks (62) as strikeouts (67). The 24-year-old also provides plus defense in the outfield. He has primarily played center field, but he has experience at all three spots.
In other roster moves, the Blue Jays placed infielder Luis Urías on the 10-day injured list with a right quad strain. They also designated outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. for assignment.

在其他阵容变动中，蓝鸟队将内野手Luis Urías放入10天伤病名单，原因是右股四头肌拉伤，并指定让渡外野手Rudy Martin Jr.。

items.titleEn: Soriano keeps it simple in 1st start for Blue Jays
bodyEn: PHILADELPHIA -- José Soriano’s first start in a Blue Jays uniform wasn’t as lengthy as they may have hoped for, but the newest member of Toronto’s rotation gave his new team a solid effort against the Phillies.
Soriano allowed two runs (one earned) over 4 2/3 innings Friday night at Citizens Bank Park, giving up four hits and three walks while striking out three.

Two of those strikeouts came at the perfect time for the right-hander, who was clinging to a one-run lead in the fifth. After walking Bryson Stott to open the inning, Soriano gave up a double to Justin Crawford, putting both the tying and go-ahead runs in scoring position.

Soriano got Kyle Schwarber to swing through a knuckle curve for the first out, then did the same to Trea Turner for the second out, throwing eight knuckle curves over 10 pitches against the pair. Reliever Mason Fluharty came in to face Bryce Harper, striking him out to preserve the Blue Jays’ lead.
Showing off his five-pitch arsenal, Soriano kept the Phillies off balance for most of his outing, looking at times like the pitcher that dominated through the first month of the season.

Manager John Schneider said before the game that he and pitching coach Pete Walker had been talking with Soriano about his approach during their first few days together, delivering a simple message to the 27-year-old: Get in the zone and trust your stuff.

“He’s had a really good year,” Schneider said. “Obviously, the first 40 innings of this year were elite for José, but there are things we've talked about in terms of not being on the edges so much, trying to dominate the 1-1 and 0-0 counts.”

Soriano didn’t throw a ball to either of the first two hitters he faced, then found himself in that 1-1 against Harper with two outs in the first inning. He threw a splitter that Harper rolled over for an easy grounder to second.

Soriano worked ahead in the count most of the time in the early innings, though a walk of Brandon Marsh in the second helped lead to the Phillies’ first run thanks to an error by Jesús Sánchez. Schwarber doubled with one out in the third, scoring on Harper’s RBI single, but Soriano managed to limit the damage, giving the Blue Jays’ offense a chance to take the lead in the fourth.

Schneider pointed to the work Dylan Cease put in with Walker and the coaching staff during Spring Training as a template they can use with Soriano, though he acknowledged the two pitchers have different stuff and personalities. Unlike Cease, who had an entire camp to work out the kinks, Soriano is joining the Blue Jays in the middle of what they hope will be a playoff push, complicating the situation to some extent.

“It has to be a little bit quick and it has to be both ways,” Schneider said. “You have to be pretty receptive to it. You want to let him do what he's comfortable with, but at the same time offer some suggestions as to what we think may make him better. There will be a little bit of back and forth. It's him trusting in that process, right? When you have a pretty good track record for success with guys, I think it's easy for the pitcher to buy into it.”
items.titleZh: 索里亚诺蓝鸟首秀化繁为简
items.summaryZh: 索里亚诺首秀投4 2/3局失2分，关键三振守住领先。
bodyZh: 费城——何塞·索里亚诺身穿蓝鸟球衣的首次先发虽然没有他们期望的那么长，但这位多伦多轮值最新成员在对阵费城人的比赛中为新球队做出了坚实的努力。
周五晚在市民银行球场，索里亚诺主投4 2/3局失两分（一分自责），被敲四支安打、送出三次保送，同时三振三人。
对于这位右投手来说，其中两次三振来得正是时候，他在第五局守着一分领先。在保送布莱森·斯托特开局后，索里亚诺被贾斯汀·克劳福德敲出二垒安打，将追平分和超前分都送到了得分位置。
索里亚诺让凯尔·施瓦伯对一颗指节曲线球挥空，取得第一个出局，然后让特雷·特纳也挥空，取得第二个出局，面对这两人共投了10球，其中8球是指节曲线球。后援投手梅森·弗卢哈蒂上场面对布莱斯·哈珀，将他三振，保住了蓝鸟的领先。
展示了他的五种球路，索里亚诺在大部分出场时间里让费城人失去平衡，有时看起来像是本赛季第一个月统治比赛的投手。
主教练约翰·施奈德赛前表示，他和投手教练皮特·沃克在最初几天一直与索里亚诺讨论他的投球策略，向这位27岁球员传递了一个简单的信息：进入好球带并相信你的球路。
“他今年表现非常好，”施奈德说，“显然，何塞今年前40局是精英级别的，但我们讨论了一些事情，比如不要太多地投在边缘，努力主宰1-1和0-0的球数。”
索里亚诺面对前两名打者都没有投出坏球，随后在第一局两人出局时与哈珀打到了1-1。他投出一颗指叉球，哈珀击出滚地球，轻松出局于二垒。
索里亚诺在早期局数大多数时候都取得球数领先，尽管第二局保送布兰登·马什后，由于赫苏斯·桑切斯的失误，导致费城人得到第一分。第三局一人出局时，施瓦伯敲出二垒安打，随后哈珀的一分打点一垒安打让他得分，但索里亚诺成功限制了伤害，让蓝鸟打线在第四局有机会取得领先。
施奈德指出迪伦·西斯在春训期间与沃克和教练团队所做的工作是他们可以用于索里亚诺的模板，尽管他承认两位投手有不同球路和性格。与拥有整个春训营来解决问题的西斯不同，索里亚诺在球队希望冲击季后赛的途中加入了蓝鸟，这使得情况在某种程度上变得复杂。
“这必须稍微快一些，而且必须是双向的，”施奈德说，“你必须非常乐于接受。你想让他做他觉得舒服的事，但同时也提供一些我们认为能让他变得更好的建议。会有一些来回交流。这就是他相信这个过程，对吧？当你与投手有很好的成功记录时，我觉得投手很容易接受这一点。”

items.titleEn: 18 days after taking liner off head, Jays' top pitching prospect dominates at Double-A
bodyEn: Nolan Perry went 18 days between starts for Double-A New Hampshire. The last time he stood on a Minor League mound was July 19, when a line drive hit him flush on the side of the head. Toronto originally stated he would be week-to-week in his concussion recovery, but after just two and a half weeks away and having cleared all protocols, he was right back on the bump.

Making his home debut at Delta Dental Stadium on Thursday night, Perry showed no signs of being worse for wear. He pumped his first two pitches right down the middle for strikes and struck out the first two batters swinging on wicked breaking balls. By the time he was done, the Blue Jays’ No. 2 prospect had tossed three no-hit frames and racked up four punchouts in New Hampshire’s 5-2 win over Portland.
Get tickets to a Minor League game near you »

At the start of 2026, Perry was a relative unknown outside of the Florida State League circuit and the Blue Jays’ complex in Dunedin. Not ranked on the club’s preseason Top 30 Prospects list, he has enjoyed a meteoric rise over the past few months, now Toronto's top-ranked pitching prospect and No. 92 overall in baseball.

All four of Perry’s punchouts Thursday came on breaking balls, benders so nasty that even catcher Aaron Parker was unable to corral the first one as it went to the backstop before he completed the out. The 22-year-old threw first-pitch strikes to nine of the 10 batters he faced and didn’t allow a ball to leave the infield, yielding a baserunner only on a hit by pitch.

By virtue of his relatively speedy recovery, the Fisher Cats were able to pencil Perry into the rotation and utilize right-hander Gage Stanifer (TOR No. 7) as a piggyback. As nasty of a one-two punch as you’ll find in the Eastern League, Stanifer struck out five (while walking five) across four one-hit, one-run frames.

Perry has been a major development success story for the Blue Jays, who nabbed him with their 12th-round selection in the 2022 Draft out of the New Mexico high school prep ranks. He was an over-slot signing but not a major one, landing a $200,000 signing bonus. After getting clobbered in his first taste of pro ball in ‘23 (7.28 ERA across nine outings in the Florida Complex League), he broke out with an impressive Single-A debut in ‘24 before his elbow gave out after 14 starts.

What a pitcher looks like post-Tommy John surgery is always up in the air, but after missing all of 2025, Perry dominated the lower levels earlier this season. He allowed one earned run or fewer in all five of his Dunedin starts before getting the bump to High-A Vancouver in May. He won Northwest League Pitcher of the Month honors in June, and by the end of that month was ready for the challenge of the upper Minors.

While Toronto has largely kept Perry’s pitch count in check as he works his way back from the torn UCL, he’s been electric when on the mound. Across 59 innings, he's allowed just 38 hits and struck out 89 batters. He ranks fourth in the system in punchouts despite that capped workload and would lead in average-against, WHIP and several other categories if he had the requisite number of innings to qualify.

There’s plenty of good news elsewhere on mounds across the farm as well: Ricky Tiedemann (TOR No. 10) -- once the club’s top pitching prospect in his own right -- returned to Triple-A Buffalo on Wednesday night and tossed a scoreless inning of relief. He averaged 96.7 mph with his fastball and has given up just one run on three hits across five innings as he returns to action after dealing with left elbow soreness earlier this year.

Toronto also welcomed aboard a pair of new faces to its deepening pitching crop earlier this week. Dasan Hill (TOR No. 6) and John Klein (No. 25) both slotted in among the organization’s Top 30 prospects after arriving in the Jeff Hoffman trade with Minnesota. Hill's first start in his new system is set for Sunday with Vancouver, where he will join fellow fast-rising southpaw Johnny King (No. 3) in the rotation.
items.titleZh: 头部被平飞球击中18天后，蓝鸟顶级投手新秀在双A联赛中展现统治力
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟投手新秀Perry在头部被平飞球击中18天后复出，3局无安打并送出4次三振。
bodyZh: Nolan Perry在双A新罕布什尔队的两次先发之间相隔了18天。他上一次站上小联盟投手丘是在7月19日，当时一颗平飞球正中他的头部侧面。多伦多最初表示他的脑震荡恢复情况将按周观察，但仅仅缺席了两个半星期并通过了所有协议后，他就重新站上了投手丘。
周四晚在Delta Dental Stadium的主场首秀中，Perry丝毫没有表现出不适。他的前两球直接投进好球带正中央，并依靠犀利的变化球让前两名打者挥空三振。退场时，这位蓝鸟2号新秀已经投出三局无安打，并送出四次三振，帮助新罕布什尔队以5-2击败波特兰。
获取您附近小联盟比赛的门票 »
在2026年年初，Perry在佛罗里达州联赛和达尼丁蓝鸟基地之外还算相对无名。他未进入球队季前30大新秀名单，但在过去几个月里迅速崛起，如今已是多伦多排名第一的投手新秀，在棒球总排名中位列第92位。
周四，Perry的全部四次三振都来自变化球，这些变化球犀利无比，第一个球甚至让捕手Aaron Parker未能接住，球滚到挡网后才完成出局。这位22岁小将面对10名打者，有9人首球好球，且没有让球飞出内场，仅因触身球让对手上垒一次。
凭借相对快速的恢复，Fisher Cats得以将Perry列入先发轮值，并使用右投手Gage Stanifer（蓝鸟第7号新秀）作为接力，这对组合是东区联盟最犀利的组合拳。Stanifer在四局中送出五次三振（也有五次保送），仅被敲一安打失一分。
Perry是蓝鸟发展体系中的一个重要成功案例。蓝鸟在2022年选秀第12轮选中了他，他当时来自新墨西哥州的高中球员行列。他是一笔溢价签约，但并非大手笔，只拿到了20万美元签约金。在2023年首次体验职业棒球时他遭到重创（在佛罗里达综合联盟的9场出赛中自责分率高达7.28），随后在2024年的1A首秀中表现出色，但他在14次先发后肘部受伤。
投手在Tommy John手术后的状态总是充满变数，但在缺席整个2025赛季后，Perry在本赛季早些时候统治了低级别联赛。他在达尼丁的5场先发中每场失分不超过1分，之后于5月升至高阶1A的温哥华。他赢得了6月份西北联盟月度最佳投手奖，并在6月底做好了迎接更高级别小联盟挑战的准备。
多伦多严格限制着Perry的用球数，因为他在从尺侧副韧带撕裂中恢复，但只要登上投手丘，他依然生猛。在59局中，他只被敲出38支安打，并三振了89名打者。尽管工作量受限，他的三振数在球队体系中排名第四，而如果他的局数达到参评标准，他将在被打击率、WHIP等多项数据中领先。
农场体系中其他投手也有不少好消息。Ricky Tiedemann（蓝鸟第10号新秀）——曾凭自身实力成为球队头号投手新秀——周三晚回到3A水牛城，后援一局无失分。他的速球平均时速96.7英里。在复出后的5局中，仅被敲3支安打失1分。他今年早些时候因左肘酸痛缺阵，如今已重返赛场。
本周早些时候，多伦多也迎来了两位新面孔，为日益深厚的投手阵容增添力量。Dasan Hill（蓝鸟第6号新秀）和John Klein（第25号新秀）在涉及Jeff Hoffman与明尼苏达的交易中加盟后，双双进入球队30大新秀名单。Hill在新体系中的首场先发定于周日随温哥华出战，届时他将与另一位迅速崛起的左投Johnny King（第3号新秀）一同进入先发轮值。

items.titleEn: Cease's 7-inning gem goes for naught in Blue Jays' deflating 11-inning loss
bodyEn: CHICAGO -- Thursday looked like one of those days where the Blue Jays could use as a reason to cling to hope for a deep postseason run, heck, or even a return of October baseball.

Dylan Cease was magnificent for seven innings, the defense was strong and the bullpen was just as solid for five outs. But the Blue Jays needed six outs from their relievers, and their woes with runners in scoring position stopped them from picking up a win in a makeup contest against the Cubs.

Alex Bregman hit a two-strike, two-out two-run home run in the ninth to force extras and Pete Crow-Armstrong scored on a throwing error from catcher Brandon Valenzuela as he stole third to walk it off and hand the Blue Jays a 3-2 loss in 11 innings at Wrigley Field.

But it likely won’t be Bregman’s blast or Crow-Armstrong’s swipe that the Blue Jays will be kicking themselves about -- it’s the 1-for-19 with runners in scoring position and the 13 runners left on base in the loss. The Blue Jays outhit the Cubs 11-5, but failed to advance the extra-innings runner past second base in both frames.

“Just didn’t get the hits we needed to,” manager John Schneider said. “There’s a lot left on. It gets magnified, obviously, in extras when you get a guy there. But just couldn’t sequence them out the way we wanted to today against [Cubs starter David] Peterson or really the rest of the way, except for [Alejandro Kirk’s RBI single in the seventh]. Had chances to add on. Leadoff double in the ninth, had a chance to add on.”

It’s been a bugaboo for the Blue Jays this season. They have the second-fewest plate appearances in baseball with runners in scoring position (991), and their .695 OPS in those situations is fifth-worst. They had runners in scoring position in eight of their 11 innings on Thursday.
And it spoiled a terrific outing from their ace, Cease. The right-hander tossed seven scoreless innings, striking out 10 and permitting just two hits and a walk.

“You want to get the offense going,” Schneider said. “You want to either get some timely hits or add some slug like we’ve talked about a lot. The other phases of the game, I like what they’re doing. I like the way they’re competing, and you got to brush this off, leave it here and go on to Philly.”

It was the continuation of a dominant stretch for Cease. The right-hander owns a 0.84 ERA (4 ER/43 IP) and 0.67 WHIP over his last six starts. He continued that hot stretch Thursday by using his full repertoire. Cease used almost all his six pitches his first time through the order, keeping the Cubs’ lineup guessing. He leaned more heavily on his fastball-slider mix as the game wore on, and that allowed him to be dominant throughout the outing.

That diversity of his pitch mix allowed the fastball-slider combo, particularly the heater, to improve as the day wore on. Cease’s average fastball velocity jumped from 94.9 mph in the first inning to a peak of 97.3 mph in the sixth. Two of his hardest thrown pitches came in the seventh.

“I feel like I’m mixing in more variety of pitches and I feel like I’m getting them to better spots, too,” Cease said. “It feels like some days in the past would really just be very slider-fastball heavy, and if I didn’t have one or the other, it would be a massive grind. Where now I can mix in a first-pitch curveball -- and go to the sweeper and go to the sinker -- and things like that that I haven’t historically done very well in the past, and that’s helping me just diversify my pitches and be less predictable.”

The Blue Jays had jumped ahead in the first inning when Kazuma Okamoto scored from third base after Peterson had disengaged three times off the mound. The left-hander threw over to first base three times to try and pick off George Springer. When the final throw over was unsuccessful, each runner was awarded a base, and that would be the Blue Jays’ lone run until Alejandro Kirk’s RBI single in the seventh.
After the loss at Wrigley, the Blue Jays sit 3 1/2 games back of the third and final Wild Card spot with 46 games remaining.
items.titleZh: Cease七局好投成空 蓝鸟11局惜败小熊
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟虽先驰得点，但得点圈打击乏力，11局遭小熊逆转，3比2落败。
bodyZh: 芝加哥——周四原本看起来是蓝鸟可以借此对深入季后赛甚至重返十月棒球保持希望的日子之一。
Dylan Cease在七局中表现出色，防守稳固，牛棚在前五个出局数中也同样扎实。但蓝鸟需要后援投手投六个出局数，而他们在得点圈有跑者时的糟糕表现令他们未能在对阵小熊的补赛中取胜。
Alex Bregman在第九局两人出局、两好球时轰出两分本垒打，将比赛拖入延长局；Pete Crow-Armstrong在盗三垒时因捕手Brandon Valenzuela的传球失误得分，完成再见跑垒，在瑞格利球场以3比2让蓝鸟在11局中落败。
但蓝鸟或许不会为Bregman的本垒打或Crow-Armstrong的盗垒而懊恼——而是得点圈有人时19打数1安打，以及留下13个跑者在垒上。蓝鸟的安打数以11比5领先小熊，但在两个延长局中均未能将自动上垒的跑者推进到二垒以后。
“我们就是没能打出需要的安打，”主教练John Schneider说。“留下了太多跑者。显然在延长局，当你有跑者在二垒时，这被放大了。但今天面对（小熊先发投手David）Peterson或者其余投手时，我们就是无法按想要的方式串联安打，除了（Alejandro Kirk在第七局的打点一垒安打）。有追加得分的机会。第九局首名打者击出二垒安打，也有追加得分的机会。”
这已经是蓝鸟本赛季的老大难问题。他们在得点圈有跑者时的打席数为991，全联盟第二少；而在这些情况下的OPS为.695，排名第五差。周四的11局中他们有8局有跑者处于得点圈。
而这也糟蹋了王牌投手Cease的一次精彩先发。这位右投手投了七局无失分，送出10次三振，只被击出两支安打和一次保送。
“你希望让进攻运转起来，”Schneider说。“你希望打出及时安打，或者像我们经常谈到的增加长打。比赛的其他环节，我喜欢他们的表现。我喜欢他们的竞争方式，你得把这场失利抛在脑后，把它留在这里，然后前往费城。”
这是Cease统治级表现期的延续。这位右投手在过去六次先发中自责分率为0.84（4自责分/43局），WHIP为0.67。周四他通过使用全部球种延续了火热状态。Cease在第一轮面对打线时几乎用了他六种球路中的全部，让小熊打线捉摸不透。随着比赛深入，他更加依赖速球和滑球的组合，这使他在整场先发中保持统治力。
球种搭配的多样性让速球-滑球组合，尤其是速球，随着比赛进行而愈发犀利。Cease的平均速球球速从第一局的94.9英里/小时提升到第六局的峰值97.3英里/小时。他投出的两颗最快速球出现在第七局。
“我觉得我在搭配更多种类的球路，而且也能把球投到更好的位置，”Cease说。“过去有些日子真的会非常依赖滑球和速球，如果其中一种感觉不好，那就会非常挣扎。而现在我可以混入首球曲球——然后使用扫球、伸卡球——这些是我过去历史上并不擅长的，这帮助我多样化我的球种，变得不那么可预测。”
蓝鸟在首局率先得分。当时Kazuma Okamoto从三垒跑回本垒，因为Peterson三次从投手板退开。这位左投手三次向一垒传球试图牵制George Springer。当最后一次牵制传球不成功时，每位跑者被判定推进一个垒包，这成为蓝鸟直到第七局Alejandro Kirk打点一垒安打之前的唯一得分。
在瑞格利球场失利后，蓝鸟在还有46场比赛的情况下，落后第三个且最后一个外卡席位3.5个胜场。
items.author: Andy Martinez

items.titleEn: 'Could we please not?': Gausman says goodbye to Blue Jays without facing them
bodyEn: CHICAGO -- In many ways, the Blue Jays playing a makeup game against the Cubs at Wrigley Field is a blessing. But there’s a part of Kevin Gausman that also hoped it was a full series.

“I wish it was for more than just one day, so I could maybe go to dinner with a couple of the guys and really say bye,” Gausman said on Thursday morning in the Cubs’ clubhouse at Wrigley Field, donning Cubs gear. “But it is what it is, at least I get to see them again.”

Gausman was dealt to the Cubs on Sunday for a pair of prospects, as the team was on a flight to Houston for a three-game set. Manager John Schneider called Gausman to the front of the plane and let him know he had been dealt to Chicago. The right-hander went back to his spot on the plane, near George Springer and Daulton Varsho (who would later be traded, too), and gave them the news.

“I just kind of went back there and stood there kind of awkwardly for a second,” Gausman said. “I think they could kind of tell something was going on. I love both those guys and thoroughly enjoyed my time with them. So saying bye to them was hard, for sure.”
The news was equally as difficult to deliver for Schneider, who had developed a close bond with Gausman during their time together in Toronto.

“I got a little emotional just because of the time he spent here, what he meant to this organization, how he felt for this organization and the city and the country and how he was just so revered, really, by a lot of the fan base,” Schneider said.

“It was weird. The timing of those things, you never really know, and we were a little bit late taking off and thought we would have landed already when the news broke, but it’s that time of year. The Trade Deadline is always weird.”

The 35-year-old followed the rest of the moves the Blue Jays made at the Deadline, noting that he “thought they did really good for the future.” While Varsho might have briefly thought he was staying in Toronto after the Blue Jays acquired José Soriano, Gausman didn’t try to stomach the “What if?” scenario of being teammates with Soriano and the Blue Jays.

“Yeah, I’m not going to say anything like that,” Gausman said. “I’m happy for them over there. I do think they got better. They definitely got younger, getting rid of me. That helps. But listen, I wish nothing but the best for that organization and especially those guys. I texted Varsh, ‘Go ‘Stros.’
“It’s weird, but it’s part of the business. It’s kind of what we sign up for.”

Gausman’s final start with the Blue Jays came on Aug. 1 against the Cardinals, meaning he was in line to start Thursday’s makeup game. But the idea of facing his former team with the emotions still raw was tough for him to stomach.

“I didn’t necessarily ask [not to pitch], but I was like, could we please not, you know,” Gausman said. “I just know it would be a lot. I just want to focus on trying to win a game and pitching against them. I think I could do it, I know those hitters pretty well over there. I know their strengths, their weaknesses.
“But I think it would be a lot mentally and for them, too.”

Instead, Gausman used Thursday as an opportunity to catch up with his teammates and issue a proper farewell, rather than a rushed one aboard a chartered plane -- or toeing the rubber to pitch against them.

“Listen, really close with all those guys and wish them nothing but the best,” Gausman said. “Looking forward to watching us play them today and seeing those guys again. But definitely glad I’m not facing them.”
items.titleZh: '我们能不这样吗？' Gausman告别蓝鸟未与老东家交手
items.summaryZh: 被交易到小熊的Gausman在补赛日与蓝鸟老队友告别，坦言不愿面对老东家。
bodyZh: 芝加哥——从很多方面来说，蓝鸟在瑞格利球场与小熊进行补赛是一件好事。但Kevin Gausman内心有一部分也希望能打满整个系列赛。
“我希望这次不止一天，这样我或许能和几个家伙共进晚餐，真正地告别，”Gausman周四早上在瑞格利球场的小熊队休息室里穿着小熊装备说。“但事实就是如此，至少我还能再见到他们。”
Gausman在周日被交易到小熊，换来两名潜力新秀，当时球队正在飞往休斯敦参加三场系列赛的航班上。主教练John Schneider把Gausman叫到飞机前部，告诉他已经交易到芝加哥。这位右投手回到自己在飞机上的座位，座位在George Springer和Daulton Varsho（后来也被交易）旁边，并把消息告诉了他们。
“我就那样走回去，有点尴尬地站了一会儿，”Gausman说。“我觉得他们大概能感觉到出了什么事。我很爱那两个家伙，非常享受和他们相处的时光。所以和他们告别当然很难。”
对于Schneider来说，传达这个消息同样困难，他在多伦多与Gausman共事期间建立了紧密的关系。
“我有点情绪化，因为他在队里待的时间、他对这支球队的意义、他对球队和这座城市以及这个国家的感情，还有他确实受到很多球迷的尊崇，”Schneider说。
“这很奇怪。这类事情的时机你永远无法预料，我们起飞晚了一点，本以为消息传出时我们已经降落了，但这就是每年的这个时候。交易截止日总是很奇怪。”
这位35岁的球员关注了蓝鸟在交易截止日的其他操作，指出他“认为他们为未来做得非常好。”尽管在蓝鸟得到José Soriano后，Varsho可能一度以为自己会留在多伦多，但Gausman没有去纠结与Soriano和蓝鸟成为队友的“如果”情景。
“是的，我不会说那样的话，”Gausman说。“我为他们高兴。我确实认为他们变好了。他们肯定变得更年轻了，把我送走了。那有帮助。但听着，我对那支球队祝愿一切顺利，尤其是那些家伙。我给Varsh发了短信，‘加油，太空人。’”
“这很奇怪，但这是生意的一部分。这就是我们选择的工作。”
Gausman为蓝鸟的最后一次先发是在8月1日对阵红雀，这意味着他本来应该在周四的补赛中先发。但在情绪尚未平复时面对老东家的想法让他难以接受。
“我并不一定要请求（不投球），但我心想，我们能不这样吗，你懂的，”Gausman说。“我知道那会很难。我只想专注于赢得一场比赛并面对他们投球。我觉得我能做到，我很了解那边的打者。我知道他们的优势和弱点。
“但我认为这在心理上会很难，对他们来说也是。”
相反，Gausman利用周四作为与队友叙旧、正式告别的机会，而不是在包机上匆匆告别，或者踏上投手丘面对他们投球。
“听着，我和那些家伙关系真的很好，祝愿他们一切顺利，”Gausman说。“期待今天看我们对他们比赛，再次见到那些家伙。但绝对庆幸我没有面对他们。”

items.titleEn: Vladdy out of lineup again while dealing with hamstring tightness
bodyEn: HOUSTON -- Vladimir Guerrero Jr. was out of the Blue Jays’ lineup for their 5-4 win in the series finale on Wednesday after he looked uncomfortable after running out a ground ball late in Tuesday’s game.

Guerrero was still available off the bench and the Blue Jays are not considering an IL stint right now, but manager John Schneider recognized that Guerrero needed a day off during a long stretch without a scheduled off day.

“He’s grinding. I think everyone is,” Schneider said. “He’s had some hamstring tightness. It’s a little bit of that to give him a blow, then a little bit of the quick turnaround, just to give him a reset. He’s feeling OK, but he’s been dealing with that and some other things for a while.”
That rest continued Thursday as Guerrero was kept out of the lineup for the second straight day while the Blue Jays faced the Cubs at Wrigley Field.

Schneider said “there’s no injury” when discussing Guerrero, but said the first baseman could benefit from another day out of the lineup. The Blue Jays arrived in Chicago late Wednesday night and will head to Philadelphia after the game to begin a three-game set against the Phillies.
“He’s feeling better,” Schneider said before Thursday’s contest. “I think it’s just a little bit of tightness still. We’ll see how he is today.”
Schneider was unsure if Guerrero would be available to pinch-hit in Thursday’s contest.
“We’ll see how he feels a little bit later today,” Schneider said. “But, we’ll kind of see if we need him, see what the game looks like and see how it feels.”

Guerrero has been dealing with that hamstring issue for a while now. That’s on top of a nagging back problem that’s dragged through the season. More than previous seasons -- or at least more publicly -- it seems like Guerrero is wearing the grind of this season, physically.

He’s also insistent that the Blue Jays can still make a run, though, and spoke Tuesday about how he needs to do more to help that happen, so Guerrero isn’t looking for off days and certainly isn’t looking for an IL stint.
“He wants to be out there. He wants to be contributing more than he is,” Schneider said. “I’ll talk to him today as the day goes, then when we get into Chicago.”
Guerrero’s numbers have been the story of the season for the 53-61 Blue Jays, batting .259 with a .687 OPS. He’s homered just six times, zero of them coming at Rogers Centre in Toronto.

There’s a valid argument to be made that, if 10 days on the shelf would help Guerrero come back refreshed and re-energized, it could help the club in the long-term without sacrificing much in the short term.

“It’s a delicate one. We’re talking about one of the most important guys on our team,” Schneider said. “I always feel good with him in the lineup, his presence, what he can do and what he has done for a long time. I’ll just continue to talk to him and see what he thinks is best for him. He’s got a pretty good feel of what is best for him and what is best for the team. This is a big boy league. If you’re feeling good enough to go and you can help us, I want you to do that.”
The Blue Jays should have a clearer picture by the time they play Thursday in Chicago, a quick one-game stop to make up for a game rained out earlier this season.
items.titleZh: Vladdy因腿筋紧绷再度缺阵
items.summaryZh: Vladdy因腿筋紧绷连续第二场缺阵，球队暂无将他放入伤病名单的计划。
bodyZh: 休斯敦——小弗拉迪米尔·格雷罗（Vladimir Guerrero Jr.）在周三系列赛收官战蓝鸟5-4取胜的比赛中未进入出场名单，此前他在周二比赛末段击出滚地球后跑垒时看起来不太舒服。
格雷罗仍可作为替补出场，蓝鸟目前并未考虑立即将他放入伤病名单，但主教练John Schneider意识到，在一段没有原定休息日的漫长赛程中，格雷罗需要一天休整。
“他在硬撑。我觉得每个人都在硬撑，”施奈德说，“他有一些腿筋紧绷。让他喘口气有这个原因，再加上赛程紧凑，让他重置一下。他感觉还好，但这个问题和其他一些小毛病已经困扰他一段时间了。”
周四，格雷罗连续第二天未进入出场名单，蓝鸟在瑞格利球场迎战小熊队。
施奈德在讨论格雷罗时表示“没有伤病”，但称这名一垒手多休息一天可能有好处。蓝鸟周三深夜抵达芝加哥，本场比赛结束后将前往费城，与费城人展开三场系列赛。
“他感觉好多了，”施奈德在周四赛前说，“我想只是还有点紧。我们看看他今天感觉如何。”
施奈德不确定格雷罗是否能在周四比赛中作为代打上场。
“我们晚些时候会看看他的感觉，”施奈德说，“但我们也会看看是否需要他，看看比赛形势如何，以及他的身体反应。”
格雷罗与腿筋问题已经缠斗了一段时间。除此之外，还有整个赛季都在拖累他的背部问题。相比以往赛季——至少从公开层面看——格雷罗本赛季在身体上承受着更多疲惫。
不过，他仍坚持认为蓝鸟仍有机会冲击季后赛，并在周二谈到他需要做得更多帮助球队实现目标，因此格雷罗并不想要休息日，当然也不想要伤病名单。
“他想上场。他想比现在贡献更多，”施奈德说，“今天随着比赛进展我会和他聊聊，然后到了芝加哥再说。”
格雷罗的数据是53胜61负的蓝鸟本赛季的一大焦点，他打击率为.259，OPS为.687。他仅打出六支本垒打，其中没有一支是在多伦多的罗杰斯中心打出的。
有一种合理的观点认为，如果让格雷罗休养10天能让他以焕然一新的状态回归，那么从长远来看对球队有利，短期也不会有太大牺牲。
“这是一个敏感的话题。我们说的是球队最重要的球员之一，”施奈德说，“他出现在出场名单中、他的存在、他的能力以及他长久以来的表现，总是让我感到安心。我会继续和他沟通，看看他认为什么最适合自己。他对自己和球队的最佳选择有很好的判断。这是职业球员的联盟。如果你觉得状态足以出战并且能帮助球队，我希望你上场。”
蓝鸟在周四芝加哥的比赛结束后应该会有更清晰的情况，这是一场速战速决的补赛，为了弥补本赛季早些时候因雨延期的比赛。
